args.command: echo '=== chrome processes ==='; pgrep -a -f 'google-chrome|chrome ' || true; echo '=== default browser ==='; update-alternatives --query x-www-browser 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true; echo '=== zenui env ==='; ls -ld /var/lib/zenui /var/lib/zenui/.config 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== recent ChatGPT login/open logs ==='; journalctl --no-pager -n 180 -u 'zen-chatgpt-gui-*' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'account/login|Opening in existing browser|https://|oauth|authorize|sign in' | tail -n 80 || true

meta.summary: Inspect Chrome launch state for ChatGPT desktop login on Mini
